1.note: no coherent family; durability is the only abstract material property, but nothing constrains it

2.note: sentimental is the off-register outlier and empirical is the default academic-prose collocate for a claim about evidence

3.note: faithful/exacting/literal are one fidelity family; idiomatic is the single option outside it

4.note: four parallel critical adjectives, none privileged; idiosyncratic chosen only as the commonest SAT key word

5.note: compounds is the only plural, so it is the grammatical odd one out in an otherwise singular set

6.note: withstands/measures/requires are literal; invites is the figurative verb SAT items are usually built on

7.note: coeval is the precise chronology term a dating passage would build toward; the others are generic evaluations

8.note: generous/provisional/incontrovertible all grade a claim's strength; representative describes a sample instead

9.note: dispositive/ubiquitous/premonitory are rare-register; contested is the plain outlier

10.note: all four are transmissible things; no signal separating them

11.note: obeyed/resented/corrected are responses to a rule and exposed is not, but the contrast could cut either way

12.note: unusual/imaginary/irrelevant dismiss the thing; unmeasured is the only technical, non-dismissive option

13.note: incomplete/unwarranted/premature grade degree of support; circular names a specific fallacy and is the odd one

14.note: credibility scale with no anchor; plausible picked as the mid-strength default

15.note: academic is the only option used in a figurative secondary sense (moot), the usual target of these items

16.note: reversible/predictable/gradual describe manner of a process, accidental describes cause, but the split is weak

17.note: decay/evaporation/drainage are loss-of-material processes; settlement is compaction and stands outside the family

18.note: forgotten/surpassed/abandoned are literal; outgrown is the metaphorical member

19.note: machinery/frugality/prosperity are economic; spareness is the aesthetic outlier a style passage would want

20.note: publicize is off-register but chronicle picked on topic fit alone

21.note: preserved/translated/disciplined act on something already there; invented is the only one that denies the tradition's antiquity
